# Command cheat-sheet

## Apps & windows
`open <app>` · `close <app>` · `focus <app>` · `maximize <app>` ·
`minimize <app>` · `uninstall <app>`

## Sound & display
`set volume 40` · `mute` · `unmute` · `increase volume` · `set brightness 70` ·
`dark mode` / `light mode`

Mute with several audio devices follows your choice in Settings ▸ General
(default: halve every device's volume; unmute restores them).

## Web
`open youtube.com` · `search weather today` — sites not on your allow-list get
a quiet "open this?" card. Manage the list in Customization, or say
`allow website youtube.com` · `disallow youtube.com` · `show allow list`.

## Modes
`create study mode chrome and youtube.com` · `activate study mode` ·
`update study mode add spotify` · `delete study mode` ·
`study mode vol 30` · `study mode theme dark` · `study mode layout`

## Reminders
`remind me to stretch at 4pm` · `remind me to standup daily at 9am` ·
`show reminders` · `delete reminder stretch`

## Scripts
`save script backup as robocopy …` · `run backup` · `show scripts` ·
`delete script backup` — running scripts requires the opt-in in Settings and
always shows the exact command first.

## Utilities
`take screenshot` · `check disk space` · `check internet` ·
`empty recycle bin` · `show clipboard history` · `snippet <name>` ·
`start pomodoro` · `undo` · `help`

## System
`shutdown` · `restart` · `sleep` · `hibernate` · `lock`

## Aliases & snippets
`alias browser as chrome` · manage snippets in Customization.

## Updates and reports
`check updates` · `install update` · `report issue`
